Empty by design — see ../README.md for sourcing.

Operators populating this directory should source from:

- NIH GTEx Histology Image Library (open-access H&E whole-slide images).
- The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) collections tagged
  `Histopathology` — most are CC-BY or PDDL; verify the per-collection
  data-use agreement before committing.
- LC25000 (Borkowski et al., 2019) is the training set used by the
  per-organ histopath modules; the source license permits research use
  but not redistribution, so do NOT commit raw LC25000 images here.

Each committed image MUST be sourced from a public-domain, CC0, or
CC-BY archive (with attribution captured in the per-fixture comment).
Tests that need this fixture call `pytest.skip` when only the
placeholder is present.

The vision e2e tests for both `lung_cancer_histopathology` and
`colon_cancer_histopathology` read from this directory — one image is
enough to drive both e2e tests (the same fixture is reused; the
disease_id in the prompt steers the LLM toward the right tool call).
